_comment: Packet 8F synthetic adapter outcomes (explicit simulation only; never live). The fixture controls ONLY the simulated adapter OUTCOME; the action contract, gate, confirmation, action hash, receipts, audit and cancellation are always real. Synthetic data only — no private content.

act.browser.read.detail: read 512 chars at the semantic selector

act.browser.fill.compensation: clear the field and restore the prior value

act.mail.send.detail: message accepted by the mail adapter

act.social.post.detail: post accepted by the social adapter

act.editor.write.detail: workspace file written with undo snapshot

act.desktop.launch.detail: launcher started the app (no app control claimed)

act.system.setting.compensation: restore the prior system setting value
